title: WAL retention and replication slots
summary: Replication slots can retain WAL while consumers lag or disconnect. Inspect slot state and retention alongside the relevant WAL filesystem; replication lag and storage pressure require separate evidence.
checks: Import approved slot aggregates and collect WAL filesystem bytes and inodes.
limitations: Slot diagnostics are catalogue guidance; no slot-management executor is installed.
applicability: PostgreSQL 18 slot schema; review other versions
